subject: Offer asset handoff + pricing gap — next steps for AWS listing
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aegis-fin.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing assets + pricing discrepancy we found

Markus —

Thanks for the call earlier. We're prepping procurement for an internal review and noticed a couple of gaps on the AWS offer page draft that we need resolved before the finance committee can sign off:

- SKU/pricing mismatch: the SKU table the seller onboarding team posted doesn't match the trial vs paid SKU mapping we received (see attached matrix). Our procurement team needs the final per-hour metering SKU and a clear private offer trial configuration.
- Evidence/controls: SOC2 evidence link in the listing points to a generic page. We need a downloadable audit report or an attestation page scoped to customer-data handling.
- AMI visibility: for our GovCloud deployment path the AMI visibility and seller account mapping must be explicit.

Can you confirm who from your side will own the pricing SKU update and whether you can provide a short private-offer template? Also please attach the final copy you plan to use on the product page (hero + 3 bullets) so our legal and procurement can run a quick read.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — we are on a procurement deadline of May 10.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Procurement — Aegis Financial

Attachments: sku_pricing_gap_matrix.xlsx, procurement_requirements.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aegis-fin.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing assets + pricing discrepancy we found

Lena —

Thank you — this is exactly the kind of clarity we want before go‑live. Quick responses below and next steps: 

1) SKU/pricing owner: Aditya (cc'd) will own the SKU reconciliation and generate a final SKU->metering matrix for the private offer. Aditya, can you take the attached matrix and produce the final file by EOD Monday (May 3)? Include both hourly and monthly equivalents and flag trial SKUs.

2) Evidence/controls: Kimberly, can you confirm the SOC2 attestation we can surface publicly? Procurement will need either a scoped PDF or a short attestation snippet we can link from the listing.

3) AMI visibility: Marissa — please confirm the AMI/SellerID mapping we intend to publish for GovCloud. If there are access constraints, provide the support path we will document.

4) Listing copy: Attached is draft v1 of the hero + bullets. Kimberly, I made three edits to the benefit bullets to better reflect our latency/cost differentiation — please review and redline inline.

Lena — we'll loop back with a consolidated package (final SKU matrix + SOC2 evidence + AMI statement + copy v2) before May 4 so you have time for procurement review. If the May 10 timeline shifts please tell us.

Best,
Markus Klein
VP - Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_listing_copy_v1.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aegis-fin.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing assets + pricing discrepancy we found

Markus / Lena —

Thanks for the context. Quick copy/legal notes after a first pass on redwood_listing_copy_v1.docx: 

- Hero headline: fine, but remove comparative claim "cheaper than X" — AWS copy rules prefer feature/benefit phrasing without named competitor comparisons. Suggest: "High-throughput LLM inference with predictable costs".
- Bullets: one bullet references "full control over KV cache" — that's an internal implementation phrase; change to "application-level caching to reduce per-request tokens".
- Evidence link: we can surface our SOC2 Type II attestation PDF. I'll export a redacted PDF scoped for listing use and upload it to S3; Lena, that will include the control summary relevant for procurement.
- Private offer/trial language: avoid absolute trial length guarantees in the public listing. We can add a line: "Private offers and trial configurations available — contact sales for terms."

I'll attach an updated copy v2 with inline redlines. Markus — we should not publish AMI details publicly beyond the basic GovCloud availability statement. Instead, the listing can say: "GovCloud deployment available; contact our marketplace support team to request AMI access and mapping." That should keep us within our security practices while giving procurement a clear path.

Kimberly Park
Senior Product Copywriter, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_listing_copy_v2.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aegis-fin.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing assets + pricing discrepancy we found

Folks —

Operational notes from the field side and timeline: 

- AMI/GovCloud: I can prepare the AMI access instructions and the seller-account mapping doc. I'll mark any steps that require a support ticket to AWS or an internal cross-account role grant. Expect a short runbook by EOD May 3.
- Co-sell enablement: once copy and evidence are finalized we'll push a field one-pager and a short demo script for Aegis. Timing: copy v2 + SOC2 PDF + SKU matrix -> after that I can spin the enablement kit in 24 hours.
- Private offer: legal/ops need the final SKU matrix to generate the private-offer template. Aditya — please prioritize the matrix so procurement can see the exact metering rates.

Marissa Cole
Director, Field Enablement, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aegis-fin.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 14:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing assets + pricing discrepancy we found

Lena —

Quick status update and attachments pack (see below). We're on track to give procurement what they need before May 4 end-of-day so you can run through your internal committee.

What I attached:
- redwood_listing_copy_v2.docx (Kimberly's edits applied; hero + 3 bullets finalized)
- sku_pricing_gap_matrix_final.xlsx (Aditya reconciled hourly/monthly SKUs and marked trial SKUs)
- SOC2_attestation_redacted.pdf (Kimberly exported the public-scoped PDF)
- ami_govcloud_runbook.txt (Marissa's short runbook and the support escalation path)

Next steps for Aegis: review attachments and tell us if you need a one-page procurement summary (we can produce a signed attestation page) or a DocuSign private-offer template. If procurement wants, we can schedule a 30-minute call with Aditya + Marissa to walk through the SKU mapping on Wednesday May 5.

Thanks — appreciate you moving quickly on the timeline, Lena.

Best,
Markus Klein
VP - Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_listing_copy_v2.docx, sku_pricing_gap_matrix_final.xlsx, SOC2_attestation_redacted.pdf, ami_govcloud_runbook.txt
